notes.title: Our games will be free!
notes.notes:
Hi!

As we're not actively making games at the moment, we thought, why not make our games free for everyone?
So free they will be starting from Monday November 21st, 2022!

We would also like to warmly thank everyone who already played our games, it meant a lot to us. We hope you had fun!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patches and fixes
notes.notes:
Hello players,

First patches and fixes to Solar Panic described below (not everything is described as they could contain spoilers):

- Tori guy flew away if you waited long enough, now he won't.
- Cherry picker can't go through the walls anymore. Well, shouldn't be able to.
- Specified some objective text.
- It was possible for a door to slam a player to a surf board and the player would get stuck... this has been fixed.
- Player could get stuck between an umbrella and a table. Can't anymore I'm afraid.
- You can now exit to menu from pause menu instead of quitting the whole game.
- And other cosmetic and minor fixes.

notes.title: Solar Panic: Utter Distress is Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36228306/1ccd66017fdba43b0d173e0b8b17f76cd9c7c8ea.jpg[/img]

Solar Panic: Utter Distress is available Now!

With a 10% discount!

Wake up as Durwood Champney, a sarcastic douche with a vendetta for early morning traffic and follow a true story that we made up. Explore exotic places filled with funny and/or stupid encounters and experience the story of a hungover ex-secret agent. A bit like James Bond without all the coolness and classiness.
